reviewer.name: Codex parent independent visual and integration review

evidence.observation: Accepted-form coil and unequal neck gestures survive native import; front clay exposes no construction regression.
Side and rear clay retain fitted head, throat and crest hierarchies; inherited sparse tail relief remains approximate.
Side and rear clay retain fitted head, throat and crest hierarchies; inherited sparse tail relief remains approximate.
Material and five-pose review preserve skin, horn and oral anatomy; independent Three comparison samples 2624 points across 164 objects with maximum error 1.233e-6 model units.
Phone framing is usable with orbit and zoom; this is desktop phone-viewport emulation, not a physical-device performance benchmark.
Skin and rigid fitted parts match at all five sampled poses; sampling is not exhaustive animation proof.

Declared minimum/interior/maximum values preserve fixed meshes, restore original geometry and retain edited state after save/reload. Imported triangulated mesh remains directly editable; no procedural recipe recovery claimed.
Native verification edited disposable copies. Production source and then-current published bytes were unchanged.
